decision.rationale: Changing or filtering boxes after inspecting the complete development response set would make the method result-dependent. The exact Qwen boxes are retained so downstream prior-quality and reconstruction comparisons measure the real prompt generator, including its weaknesses.

evidence._refresh_note: rebound evidence SHAs to current on-disk LF files (no scientific content changed)

visual_review: Some minimum-area BrainWeb boxes collapse to approximately one pixel and miss the displayed hotspot.
HECKTOR boxes frequently select one central or peripheral bright region rather than all visible high-uptake regions.
A small number of HECKTOR boxes cover nearly the full image.
The observed failures are semantic model-output failures, not evidence of a systematic coordinate-transform or prompt-image provenance error.

required_reporting_and_ablations: Report terminal-failure rates and box-area distributions separately by dataset and count level.
Do not claim that Qwen boxes reliably enclose every bright uptake region.
Compare exact Qwen boxes with full-image, geometric-center, and intensity-centroid boxes under matched decoder-training and reconstruction settings.
Retain the preregistered box-perturbation analysis and report the weaker HECKTOR bright-region coverage.
Do not make clinical localization or segmentation-accuracy claims from this box audit.
